description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand, managing user authentication state with persistence and providing methods for login, logout, signup, and fetching user info.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token in the store.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user information in the store.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing token and user info, and optionally calls the backend logout endpoint.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login by sending credentials to the backend, handles response, and updates store.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided credentials, updates store upon success.

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches current user info based on stored token, clears session if token is invalid.
